{{Quote|You! Farmer loud-mouth! In this line is no one who cares! You are understanding? Only one thing mattering now is to kill much Tuskens before they are killing you, uh?|The Trandoshan's last words|<ref name="SW7" />}}
A [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] '''individual''' was an [[Arms dealer/Legends|arms dealer]] who worked with the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Weazel/Legends|Weazel]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. The two were set up at the trading site [[Mochot Steep/Legends|Mochot Steep]] when the Trandoshan was shot in the head and [[Death/Legends|killed]] by an advancing [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raider]] party who then [[Attack on Mochot Steep|attacked]] the site.
